title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1973-03-26
lineage: SBD> MR> DAT> CDA> CDA> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a soaring 1973 show featuring the legendary Truckin’ → WRS Prelude jam and a stunning Candyman solo.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp, deep mix that lets Jerry Garcia’s guitar tone shine—especially on the Candyman solo—and captures an energetic set highlighted by the Truckin' into Wharf Rat (WRS) Prelude jam.  Listeners note strong second‑set momentum with Wolfman Jack’s intro and a powerful overall band performance, despite minor annoyances like misplaced tuning gaps and mis‑titled track listings.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) with detailed praise of both performance and sound quality; minor technical complaints do not outweigh the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and well‑balanced; listeners love Garcia’s tone and overall depth.  Some note tuning gaps placed at song starts and occasional mis‑titled tracks, but no major dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid with a few mis‑named tracks; second set fires up after Wolfman Jack’s intro, featuring extended jams and strong song transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar tone is highlighted as phenomenal on Candyman and throughout the jam; vocals described as deep and clear.
band_member_comments.Phil: Backing vocal contributions noted; occasional mention of Phil’s presence in harmonies.
